title: Fyodorov's Russian Cosmism and resurrection

tellings.quote: It began with a librarian and philosopher named Nikolai Fyodorov, who believed the true task of humanity and Christianity was not to await resurrection, but to cause it.

plain: A Russian librarian and philosopher named Nikolai Fyodorov believed that the true task of humanity and of Christianity was not to wait for the resurrection of the dead but to bring it about. Michels tells this himself, without naming a source, as the starting point of Russian Cosmism, a movement that joined that religious aim to science and space travel, and he raises it in an episode on NASA and secret science because it would mean the space age had roots in a hope of defeating death.
